mechanism: Eslicarbazepine induces CYP3A4 and CYP2C19, potentially reducing primaquine metabolite formation and efficacy, while primaquine may cause hemolytic anemia in G6PD-deficient patients with unpredictable enzyme induction effects on metabolism.
action: Monitor for reduced antimalarial efficacy and hemolytic complications; consider alternative antimalarials or ensure G6PD screening is completed; assess for signs of hemolysis if combination is necessary.
